output.question: Who is Walmart's CEO?
output.answer: John Furner is the President and CEO of Walmart Inc. He took over from Doug McMillon on February 1, 2026. Walmart's board announced the succession in November 2025, and McMillon retired on January 31, 2026. Before this, Furner was president and CEO of Walmart U.S. (from November 2019) and CEO of Sam's Club (from 2017). He started at Walmart in 1993 as an hourly store associate.

key_facts.fact: Walmart's corporate leadership page lists John Furner as President and CEO of Walmart Inc., leading 2.1 million associates.
Walmart's board elected John Furner to succeed Doug McMillon as President and CEO, effective February 1, 2026.
Doug McMillon retired on January 31, 2026, and stayed on the Board of Directors until the next annual shareholders' meeting.

passages.quote: John Furner is president and chief executive officer of Walmart Inc., leading 2.1 million associates around the world.
its Board of Directors has elected John Furner, 51, to succeed Doug McMillon, 59, as President and Chief Executive Officer ... effective February 1, 2026
McMillon will retire on January 31, 2026, but remain on the Board of Directors until the next annual shareholders' meeting

caveats: The leadership page shows Furner's current title, but it has no publication date and doesn't say when he started the role. The February 1, 2026 start date comes from the November 2025 announcement.
Walmart Inc.'s CEO (Furner) is a different role from the CEO of the Walmart U.S. segment. I did not check who succeeded Furner at Walmart U.S.
Furner's earlier career dates (Sam's Club CEO in 2017, Walmart U.S. CEO in November 2019, joining in 1993) come from search-result summaries, not pages I opened.
missing_fields: Successor as CEO of Walmart U.S. (not verified)
